description: This Kotlin source file defines the SavedCouponsStore class, which provides local persistence for recently used coupon codes in an Android app. It uses SharedPreferences to store a JSON list of codes, handling normalization, insertion, removal, checking for existence, and clearing the list.

classes.name: SavedCouponsStore
classes.description: A class managing persistent storage of coupon codes using SharedPreferences, with methods to load, add, remove, check, and clear saved coupons.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of saved coupon codes, returning them ordered from most recent to oldest, de-duped and normalized.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new coupon code to the stored list, de-duplicating, normalizing, and enforcing a maximum item count.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified coupon code from the saved list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all saved coupon codes from storage.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if a coupon code exists in the saved list, case-insensitive.

methods.name: saveInternal
methods.description: Serializes and saves the updated list of coupons to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes coupon codes by trimming whitespace and converting to uppercase.
